utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good afternoon. Please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is the case number IT-02-57-I, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: May I have the appearances.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Peter McCloskey with Janet Stewart for the Office of the Prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour my name is Zoran Zivanovic. I'm an attorney from Belgrade assigned as lead counsel to Mr. Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Zivanovic. Mr. Popovic, can you hear the proceedings in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If you could identify yourself with your full name and date of birth, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] My name is Vujadin Popovic, born on the 4th of March, 1957 in the Sekovici municipality. Village, Canici [phoen], Sekovici municipality.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Popovic. Please have a seat. These proceedings are the initial appearance of Mr. Vujadin Popovic pursuant to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the International Tribunal. The indictment against the accused was confirmed about three years ago on the 26th of March, in the year of 2002 and Mr. Popovic was transferred to The Hague last week on Thursday, April 14th. Upon the transfer of the accused, this case was assigned to Trial Chamber III by the order of the President, although judge Ian Bonomy -- is there any problem? Now you're following us?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Although Judge Ian Bonomy is to be the pre-trial judge for this case, I'm presiding over this case as member of trial Chamber III. The first thing I would like to do now is to make certain that the accused understands the indictment against himself. Mr. Zivanovic, has your client received the indictment in his own language?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, my client has received the indictment -- the indictment and he fully understands it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Zivanovic. It is the right of the accused to have the indictment read out in full in a language he understand. Mr. Zivanovic, does your client wish to have the indictment read out in full?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: The reading of the indictment is not necessary, because my client know it. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. The next step is an entry of the plea to the charges of the indictment. The accused may enter a plea within 30 days of the initial appearances but he may enter a plea at the time of the initial appearance if he so wishes.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: He will plead today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Mr. Popovic, if you could rise and plead to each count on the indictment which I will put to you. In entering plea, please confine your answer to either guilty or not guilty. Count 1A charges you in relation to the events that happened in and around Srebrenica, Bratunac and Zvornik in 1995 with genocide, punishable under Articles 4(3)(a) and 7(1) of the Statute of this Tribunal. Mr. Popovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In the alternative to the above genocide charges, Count 1B charges you with complicity to commit genocide punishable under Articles 4(3)(e) and 7(1). Mr. Popovic, how do you plead?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Count 2 charges you in relation to the same events, with extermination as a crime against humanity, punishable under Articles 5(b) and 7(1). Mr. Popovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty:

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The third count charges you with murder as a crime Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts. against humanity, punishable under Articles 5(a) and 7(1). Do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Count 4, charges you with murder as a violation of the laws or customs of war punishable under Articles 3 and Article 7(1). Mr. Popovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Count 5 charges you with persecutions on political, racial and religious grounds as a crime -- sorry, as a crime against humanity, including murder, cruel and inhumane treatment, terrorising the civilian population, destruction of personal property, and forcible transfer, punishable under Articles 5(h) and 7(1). Do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Count 6, the last count, charges you with forcible transfer under the category of inhumane acts, as a crime against humanity, which is punishable under Articles 5(i) and 7(1). Mr. Popovic, do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Please have a seat. I would like to ask the registrar to note that Mr. Popovic has pled not guilty to all the counts of the indictment. Mr. McCloskey, I would like to turn to you to remind you of your duty pursuant to Rule 66(A)(i) to make available, within 30 days from now, to the Defence all the supporting material which accompanied the indictment when the confirmation was sought, as well as all prior statements of the accused obtained by the Prosecution, in a language which the accused understands.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. We should be able to get a complete package to the accused by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Then I will now turn to the Defence. Mr. Zivanovic, I am hereby informing the Defence that pursuant to Rule 72(A) it will have a 30-day period for filing any preliminary motions once it has received all of the supporting materials in accordance with Rule 66 (A)(i).

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: I am aware of it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Zivanovic. The Pre-Trial Judge, Judge Bonomy, will have a status conference within approximately four months' time from today. The parties will be informed in due course. In the meantime pursuant to Rule 65 ter, the Pre-Trial Judge may be assisted in the performance of his duties by the senior legal officer of the Chamber. In this regard, I believe that the senior legal officer will schedule a meeting with the parties after the time period for the Rule 66(A)(i) disclosure and before the date of next status conference in due course, in due manner. I think I've dealt with all of the items I've noted down for today's agenda. If there is any matter for the parties to raise, I am ready to hear them. Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Just for information and for everyone -- and I think I have said it before at other appearances -- but it is the Office of the Prosecutor's intention to file a motion to join all of these Srebrenica accused, and I -- at this point I can name those that are now in custody: Pandurevic, Beara, Drago Nikolic, Borovcanin, Miletic, and Gvero. And I know with the 30 days to challenge the indictment running and many of the accused don't have lawyers yet, and whenever I sit down to type this motion up, we appear to get another accused. So I think we're almost to the end of our accused so I hope to have this motion in soon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: It must be noted by the Defence. Is there any matter Defence would like to raise, Mr. Zivanovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Not at the moment, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Popovic, what is -- apart from what is discussed so far, is there anything you would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Please have a seat. That concludes the proceeding for today. The hearing is adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.45 p.m.
